summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting the September 11, 2026 board appointment of George R. Oliver and Mark Eubanks as independent directors effective September 24, 2026. Compensation includes $90,000 annual cash, a pro-rated RSU award, and $235,000 annual RSUs. It also covers standard indemnification, D&O insurance, and a related press release. No transaction, financial terms, or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine board-composition current report with no arbitrage angle.
